## Browse by Special


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis

base_dir <- "."

excluded_dirs <- c(
  "index_files",
  "_site",
  "_freeze",
  ".quarto",
  "Images",
  "images"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Find top-level dashboard folders only
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dashboard_dirs <- list.dirs(
  path = base_dir,
  recursive = FALSE,
  full.names = FALSE
)

dashboard_dirs <- dashboard_dirs[
  !startsWith(dashboard_dirs, ".") &
    !dashboard_dirs %in% excluded_dirs
]

dashboard_dirs <- sort(dashboard_dirs)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Safely encode paths while keeping folder separators
# ------------------------------------------------------------

encode_relative_url <- function(path) {

  path <- gsub("\\\\", "/", path)

  parts <- strsplit(
    path,
    "/",
    fixed = TRUE
  )[[1]]

  encoded_parts <- vapply(
    parts,
    utils::URLencode,
    character(1),
    reserved = TRUE
  )

  paste(
    encoded_parts,
    collapse = "/"
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Find the dashboard HTML
#
# Normal structure:
# MD 1/docs/index.html
#
# Match Previews structure:
# Match Previews/index.html
# ------------------------------------------------------------

find_dashboard_html <- function(folder, base_dir = ".") {

  folder_path <- file.path(
    base_dir,
    folder
  )

  if (!dir.exists(folder_path)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }


  # Match Previews has index.html directly in the folder
  if (tolower(basename(folder)) == "match previews") {

    preview_index <- file.path(
      folder_path,
      "index.html"
    )

    if (file.exists(preview_index)) {
      return(preview_index)
    }

    return(NA_character_)
  }


  # Standard dashboards use a docs folder
  child_dirs <- list.dirs(
    folder_path,
    recursive = FALSE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  docs_match <- child_dirs[
    tolower(basename(child_dirs)) == "docs"
  ]

  if (!length(docs_match)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  docs_dir <- docs_match[1]

  html_files <- list.files(
    docs_dir,
    pattern = "\\.html$",
    full.names = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  if (!length(html_files)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }


  # Prefer index.html
  index_file <- html_files[
    tolower(basename(html_files)) == "index.html"
  ]

  if (length(index_file)) {
    return(index_file[1])
  }


  # Otherwise try an HTML file matching the dashboard folder
  dashboard_name <- basename(folder)

  expected_names <- tolower(
    c(
      paste0(dashboard_name, ".html"),
      paste0(
        gsub("\\s+", "-", dashboard_name),
        ".html"
      ),
      paste0(
        gsub("\\s+", "_", dashboard_name),
        ".html"
      )
    )
  )

  matching_file <- html_files[
    tolower(basename(html_files)) %in% expected_names
  ]

  if (length(matching_file)) {
    return(matching_file[1])
  }


  # Final fallback
  sort(html_files)[1]
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Find the output directory containing images
# ------------------------------------------------------------

find_output_dir <- function(folder, html_path) {

  if (is.na(html_path)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  # For Match Previews this is:
  # Match Previews/
  #
  # For standard dashboards this is:
  # MD 1/docs/
  dirname(html_path)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Find thumbnail
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pick_dashboard_thumb <- function(
  folder,
  output_dir,
  base_dir = "."
) {

  fallback <- "Images/champions-league-ball.png"


  # Match Previews is an index page, so use fallback image
  if (tolower(basename(folder)) == "match previews") {
    return(fallback)
  }


  if (
    is.na(output_dir) ||
    !dir.exists(output_dir)
  ) {
    return(fallback)
  }


  # Search recursively for the probability plot
  image_files <- list.files(
    output_dir,
    pattern = "\\.(png|jpg|jpeg|webp)$",
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  if (!length(image_files)) {
    return(fallback)
  }


  probability_plot <- image_files[
    grepl(
      "Match[ _-]*Result[ _-]*Probab.*lity[ _-]*Plot",
      basename(image_files),
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ]

  if (!length(probability_plot)) {
    return(fallback)
  }


  base_normalised <- normalizePath(
    base_dir,
    winslash = "/",
    mustWork = FALSE
  )

  image_normalised <- normalizePath(
    probability_plot[1],
    winslash = "/",
    mustWork = FALSE
  )

  relative_path <- substring(
    image_normalised,
    nchar(base_normalised) + 2
  )

  gsub(
    "\\\\",
    "/",
    relative_path
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract subtitle from HTML
# ------------------------------------------------------------

extract_subtitle <- function(html_path) {

  x <- tryCatch(
    readLines(
      html_path,
      warn = FALSE,
      encoding = "UTF-8"
    ),
    error = function(e) character(0)
  )

  if (!length(x)) {
    return("Open dashboard")
  }

  txt <- paste(
    x,
    collapse = "\n"
  )


  # Try HTML title
  title_match <- regexpr(
    "(?is)<title>\\s*([^<]+?)\\s*</title>",
    txt,
    perl = TRUE
  )

  if (title_match[1] != -1) {

    title <- sub(
      "(?is).*<title>\\s*([^<]+?)\\s*</title>.*",
      "\\1",
      regmatches(txt, title_match),
      perl = TRUE
    )

    title <- gsub(
      "\\s*\\|\\s*.*$",
      "",
      title
    )

    title <- gsub(
      "\\s*-\\s*Quarto$",
      "",
      title
    )

    title <- trimws(title)

    if (nzchar(title)) {
      return(title)
    }
  }


  # Fall back to first H1
  h1_match <- regexpr(
    "(?is)<h1[^>]*>\\s*([^<]+?)\\s*</h1>",
    txt,
    perl = TRUE
  )

  if (h1_match[1] != -1) {

    h1 <- sub(
      "(?is).*<h1[^>]*>\\s*([^<]+?)\\s*</h1>.*",
      "\\1",
      regmatches(txt, h1_match),
      perl = TRUE
    )

    h1 <- trimws(h1)

    if (nzchar(h1)) {
      return(h1)
    }
  }

  "Open dashboard"
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Build dashboard cards
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cards <- vapply(
  dashboard_dirs,
  function(folder) {

    full_html_path <- find_dashboard_html(
      folder,
      base_dir
    )

    if (is.na(full_html_path)) {
      return(NA_character_)
    }

    output_dir <- find_output_dir(
      folder,
      full_html_path
    )


    # Convert HTML path to a relative path
    base_normalised <- normalizePath(
      base_dir,
      winslash = "/",
      mustWork = FALSE
    )

    html_normalised <- normalizePath(
      full_html_path,
      winslash = "/",
      mustWork = FALSE
    )

    relative_html_path <- substring(
      html_normalised,
      nchar(base_normalised) + 2
    )

    dashboard_url <- encode_relative_url(
      relative_html_path
    )


    subtitle <- extract_subtitle(
      full_html_path
    )


    thumbnail_path <- pick_dashboard_thumb(
      folder = folder,
      output_dir = output_dir,
      base_dir = base_dir
    )

    thumbnail_url <- encode_relative_url(
      thumbnail_path
    )


    dashboard_name <- basename(folder)


    sprintf(
      paste0(
        '<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-6 g-col-lg-4">\n',
        '  <div class="card season-card">\n',
        '    <div class="season-card-media">\n',
        '      <img src="%s" class="card-img-top img-fluid" alt="%s thumbnail">\n',
        '    </div>\n',
        '    <div class="card-body">\n',
        '      <h3><a href="%s">%s</a></h3>\n',
        '      <div class="text-muted">%s</div>\n',
        '    </div>\n',
        '  </div>\n',
        '</div>\n'
      ),
      thumbnail_url,
      htmltools::htmlEscape(dashboard_name),
      dashboard_url,
      htmltools::htmlEscape(dashboard_name),
      htmltools::htmlEscape(subtitle)
    )

  },
  character(1)
)


cards <- cards[
  !is.na(cards)
]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Output card grid
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if (length(cards) == 0) {

  knitr::asis_output(
    '<p>No dashboard folders containing an HTML page were found.</p>'
  )

} else {

  output <- paste0(
    '<div class="grid">\n',
    paste(
      cards,
      collapse = "\n"
    ),
    "\n</div>\n"
  )

  knitr::asis_output(output)
}
```
